result.instructions: Tools for Codemagic, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Codemagic data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run codemagic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run codemagic_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run codemagic_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. codemagic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: codemagic_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List all applications (apps) in the Codemagic account, with their ids, names, and workflow ids. Codemagic REST: GET /apps.

tools.name: codemagic_get_application
tools.title: Get application
tools.description: Get a single application (app) by id. Codemagic REST: GET /apps/{id}.

tools.name: codemagic_list_builds
tools.title: List builds
tools.description: List builds, optionally filtered by application, workflow, and/or branch. Codemagic REST: GET /builds.

appId.description: Restrict to builds for this application id.

workflowId.description: Restrict to builds for this workflow id.

branch.description: Restrict to builds for this branch.

tools.name: codemagic_get_build
tools.title: Get build
tools.description: Get a single build by id, including its status. Codemagic REST: GET /builds/{id}.

tools.name: codemagic_list_caches
tools.title: List caches
tools.description: List the build caches for an application (id, size, last used, workflow). Codemagic REST: GET /apps/{appId}/caches.

tools.name: codemagic_get_artifact_download_url
tools.title: Get artifact download URL
tools.description: Get an authenticated download URL for a build artifact by its secure filename (from a build's artifacts list). Codemagic REST: GET /artifacts/{secureFilename}.

secureFilename.description: The secure filename/path of the artifact (from a build's artifacts list).

tools.name: codemagic_start_build
tools.title: Start build
tools.description: Start a new build for an application workflow. `appId` and `workflowId` are required; optionally target a branch or tag and pass environment/labels/instanceType. Codemagic REST: POST /builds.

tag.description: The tag to build (alternative to branch).

environment.description: Environment overrides for this build (variables, groups, etc.).

labels.description: Labels to attach to this build.

instanceType.description: The build machine instance type (e.g. mac_mini_m2, linux_x2).

tools.name: codemagic_cancel_build
tools.title: Cancel build
tools.description: Cancel a running build by id. Codemagic REST: POST /builds/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: codemagic_create_artifact_public_url
tools.title: Create artifact public URL
tools.description: Create a public (shareable, time-limited) download URL for a build artifact by its secure filename. Codemagic REST: POST /artifacts/{secureFilename}/public-url.

secureFilename.description: The secure filename/path of the artifact (from a build's artifacts list).

expiresAt.description: When the public URL should expire, as a UNIX timestamp in SECONDS.
